trap.label: ativa × passiva
trap.wrong: The words were written by I, and the letters are send by the postman.
trap.right: The words were written by me, and the letters are sent by the postman.
trap.why: Em português “escritas por mim” usa mim após preposição. Em inglês by + pronome objeto (me), e a passiva exige particípio (sent).

mcq.q: Active: I wrote the words. Passive: The words ___.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “I wrote the words.”
rewrite.answer: The words were written by me.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a ativa: “The letters are delivered by the postman.”
Passe para o presente passivo: “The words were written.”
